content: Common game-dev portfolio site mistakes: showing too much/unpolished work (broken WebGL builds, unfinished tutorial clones) erodes trust in everything else; overly long intro animations, confusing navigation, and heavy pages that load slowly frustrate recruiters doing fast scans; resumes listing responsibilities instead of concrete results/technical specifics; leaving stale old work in the portfolio too long; forgetting to link resume/contact/socials clearly.
